articles.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
articles.snippet: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

articles.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
articles.snippet: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

articles.title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
articles.snippet: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure buildout.

articles.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.

articles.title: Decrypt Becomes First News Publisher to Offer Perps Trading, Powered by Solana's Phoenix
articles.snippet: The integration brings perpetual futures trading into Decrypt, so readers can trade crypto, stocks and commodities without leaving the news.
